Lamprĭdĭus , ii, m.
I. Aelius, a Roman historiographer, one of the Scriptores Historiae Augustae, Vopisc. Prob. 2 fin.; cf. Teuffel, Gesch. der Röm. Lit. § 397, 4.—
II. A Latin orator of the fifth century, Sid. Ep. 8, 11; cf. Teuffel, Gesch. der Röm. Lit. § 459, 6.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
